text: Possible phishing email reported by branch staff. Subject says urgent account verification and links to a fake login page.
Klient dostał SMS o zablokowaniu konta i link prosi o podanie hasła. Podejrzenie phishingu.
Multiple failed logins detected for one employee account within 2 minutes.
ATM at branch 14 shows tamper warning; device taken out of service.
Пользователь сообщил, что приложение банка просит повторно ввести PIN-код после перехода по ссылке из письма.
Firewall log: repeated inbound connections to an exposed admin port from an unfamiliar external IP.
Nie działa MFA dla kilku pracowników, logowanie do systemu bankowego jest utrudnione.
Customer says card payment was declined, but no suspicious activity is visible in the monitoring dashboard.
Potential data leak: report exported to an unapproved personal cloud drive.
SOC alert: endpoint protection quarantined a file named invoice_update.exe.
Several customers report calls from someone pretending to be bank support and asking for one-time codes.
Wykryto nietypowy transfer danych z serwera plików poza standardowymi godzinami pracy.
VPN connection from a new country; employee confirms they are travelling and initiated the login.
Database backup failed last night. No evidence of unauthorized access; retry scheduled.
Suspicious email attachment opened on a workstation; user disconnected it from the network and contacted IT.
Забыли продлить сертификат TLS, портал интернет-банка показывает предупреждение браузера.
Possible ransomware note appeared on one test laptop; production systems not yet confirmed affected.
Dziwne logowania do konta administratora o 03:14, source unknown, pls investigate asap!!!
Customer reports a card transaction they do not recognize. Could be fraud; card has been temporarily blocked.
Patch for a critical vulnerability is available, but deployment is waiting for the approved maintenance window.
The bank's public website is slow. Monitoring shows high traffic, but no confirmed DDoS attack.
Pracownik przypadkowo wysłał plik z danymi testowymi na zewnętrzny adres. Plik nie zawiera prawdziwych danych klientów.
EDR says malware blocked; host ID WS-204. Need check whether any persistence remains.
A customer cannot reset their password because the recovery email never arrives.
В журнале обнаружены успешные входы после серии неудачных попыток. Нужно проверить возможный взлом учётной записи.
Pen test found an IDOR issue in the internal training portal; no production customer data involved.
Nieznane urządzenie podłączone do portu sieciowego w oddziale. Technik sprawdza, czy to zatwierdzony sprzęt.
A staff member reports that their laptop camera light turned on unexpectedly after opening a suspicious document; no malware alert yet.
Backup restoration test completed successfully. This is a routine change, no incident detected.
URGENT!!! core banking API returns 500 errors after deployment; transactions are delayed, cause not yet known.
